prompt:
Create ONE polished landscape reference/perspective sheet for Bellweather Sheep, for an original painterly RTS. Use the attached Bellweather ecology image ONLY to identify its middle-left sheep and its illustration style; do not include any other animal, plant, rock, field-guide specimen, or scenery. This is one same individual animal throughout, a cream-fleeced short stocky sheep with broad overlapping wool locks, a pale longish sheep face, outward lateral brown-pink ears, four bare lower legs and dark cloven hooves, a small woolly tail, no horns, no harness, no ornaments and no anthropomorphic face. Preserve the same skull, muzzle, ear attachment, body volume, tail and leg proportions across every view. Anatomically credible quadruped, exactly four legs; some legs may be occluded correctly but never fuse, add or detach them. Neutral planted standing pose, no walking, no jump.

Layout: clean warm ivory background, restrained gray technical construction guides, ample gutters, eight separate complete sheep studies in TWO ROWS of FOUR, consistent drawn body scale with no cropping. Small elegant readable heading 'BELLWEATHER SHEEP — REFERENCE STUDY v1'. Top row: orthographic anatomy views labelled Front, Left profile, Right profile, Rear. Profiles are actual opposite sides of the same sheep, front/rear unmistakable. Plain measured silhouette/proportion bars, not elaborate scenery. Bottom row: four fixed-camera game-perspective STUDIES, labelled World yaw 0, 90, 180, 270. The camera stays at 45-degree azimuth and 45.4359024848-degree elevation above the ground, orthographic, world Y up; rotate the SHEEP around its vertical axis for each panel, not the camera. World yaw zero faces +Z. Use consistent upper-left soft light, broad readable fleece masses, planted hoof-plane contact. Indicate a small identical ground cross at the center between the four hooves in each bottom panel: this is the proposed root/pivot; no changing root registration. Draw thin ground axes and subtle projection guides, not UI selection rings.

Record proposed design dimensions as one clean footer: 'Trial scale: shoulder 0.60 world units · nose to rump 0.90 · root at hoof plane'. Add footer 'Concept turnaround and camera studies — not game-ready sprites'. These are planning targets, not a certification of mechanically measured output. Keep the face, ears, back and leg lengths coherent. No mirror-copy cheat for the rear view, no asymmetric missing limbs, no labels printed on the body, no gore, no death pose, no other creatures, no photographic rendering, no 3D plastic material, no watermark. Beautiful confident painterly game illustration with a calm, practical pastoral identity and strong silhouette.
